rows.name: Prime Agent
rows.evolving_object: supplemental harness state and task artifacts; model weights fixed
rows.preserved_unit: daemon session + REPL values + versioned memories/skills + full history
rows.horizon: many tool turns, compaction/restart, multi-day case studies
rows.adopt: raw event addresses; execution/state separation; root+descendant resource accounting; evidence-derived small refinements
rows.not_copy: a second runtime or unconditional promotion of learned skills
rows.limitation: external ARC references are not causal harness controls; nanoGPT final-record effect small relative to noise; a Factorio exploit became a skill

rows.name: Harness-of-Harness
rows.evolving_object: software artifact A_t and evidence E_t; underlying harness/model/roles fixed
rows.preserved_unit: frozen candidate, independent QA report, preservation constraints
rows.adopt: small coherent increments; single writer; developer tests separate from frozen-candidate QA; explicit unresolved gaps
rows.not_copy: mandatory feature growth when only safe research step is falsification; extra competing supervisor; replacing failed attempts in research denominator
rows.limitation: same-model independent role not independent scorer truth; 3-pass control unequal tokens; no public HoH-lite core at pinned tree

rows.name: HarnessDev
rows.evolving_object: frozen reusable harness H; creator/executor separated
rows.preserved_unit: frozen versions + feedback vs held-out evaluations
rows.horizon: creation then 9 evolution lineages/73 versions, not 73 independent agents
rows.adopt: creator/executor distinction; frozen held-out final selection; check code path activation; score and full cost separately
rows.not_copy: post-hoc collapsed-run exclusions; external human-reference row as paired causal control; using feedback max as deployment score
rows.limitation: one evolution trajectory per cell, heldout only SWE-Pro; execution-token accounting excludes creator cost

rows.name: Scroll
rows.evolving_object: working view over persistent session environment
rows.preserved_unit: append-only events/payloads with seq pointers; typed variables; eviction landmarks
rows.horizon: 115K–10M history and long tool-use state, not necessarily multi-day autonomy
rows.adopt: locate/materialize/compute/expose separation; recoverable source-backed view; explicit off-view anchors
rows.not_copy: claim that raw-byte recoverability guarantees retrieval or decision sufficiency; replace canonical evidence with model summaries
rows.limitation: same-backbone LOCA256K 86.7 vs CodeAct85.3; published +37.4 is cross-system/backbone; retrieval failure despite preserved history

rows.name: SkillZip (contract graph)
rows.evolving_object: source-grounded section graph, macro dictionary, query hydration
rows.preserved_unit: occurrence-specific ports/resources/guards/verifier paths and reversible source maps
rows.horizon: growing library and repeated reuse; not a general scientific workflow result
rows.adopt: contract-bearing reuse unit; expand before trusting uncertain boundary; versioned macro consumers; rare-branch tests
rows.not_copy: all typed graphs are new; structural reachability as scientific validity; claimed lossless semantic execution
rows.limitation: structural not semantic theorem; human extraction exact-match84.6%; first-view DPR99.2/VR98.7; overhead excludes extraction in some figures

rows.name: RecEvolve
rows.evolving_object: recommender architecture/configuration and shared research knowledge
rows.preserved_unit: central orchestrator state; stateless workers; isolated experiment records; negative history
rows.horizon: 41 completed experiments in ~2 days/5 threads, not replications
rows.adopt: hypothesis→critique→isolated implementation→full evaluation; negative findings with regime-qualified reuse/reopen rules
rows.not_copy: global ban on all failed ideas; proxy-metric optimizer; production A/B authorization; claimed autonomous fraud detection
rows.limitation: batch-size shortcut was human detected; LLM/repeats/AB denominators unclear; plateau and repeated failures

rows.name: Meta^n
rows.evolving_object: nested preprocessing/helper-code chains produced by fixed Omega
rows.horizon: depth and outer search, distinct from elapsed duration or inner turns
rows.adopt: fixed improver contract; comparable trace+code inputs; separate hypothesis refine from evaluator/authority invariants
rows.not_copy: unbounded recursive self-modification; archive per-task max as single deployable chain; monotone score as valid retained evidence
rows.limitation: layer interference/regression exists; same model at solver and improver within each run; heterogeneous stronger-improver transfer untested; depth max/patience exist; archive-best vs chain differs

rows.name: Terminal-Universe
rows.evolving_object: recovered workspace then synthesized tasks/trajectories and trained weights
rows.preserved_unit: pre-change observed files + explicitly generated completion + per-round requirements/tests
rows.horizon: cross-workspace breadth and cumulative multi-round tasks
rows.adopt: trace-derived replay candidates; explicit original vs inferred bytes; requirement changes; prior-regression and new-check separation; source-family heldout split
rows.not_copy: lossless inverse of arbitrary traces; task-sufficient as original-environment equivalence; success-only/trailing-trim policy for research reporting
rows.limitation: reconstruction inherently lossy; single teacher authors tasks/solutions/verifiers; SFT gains not frozen-harness treatment effects
